title: They said 'see ya.' I built a monster.
caption: "See ya" instead of "see you" and a what-if hatches. Every what-if you feed it makes it bigger, until it's stomping through a lovely evening. One simple question shrinks it fast. Send this to the friend who made a chart about a text.
